title: Reviewing a finished conference program
passage: The conference programs are printed, but please hold the full batch at the binding station. At twelve, we’ll bring one finished copy to the reception desk. The event team needs to check where the fold falls on the room map. They have already approved the text. When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper. If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me. Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.
passageZh: 會議節目冊已印好，但請先把整批留在裝訂區。十二點時，我們會把一本成品送到接待櫃檯。活動團隊要確認折線落在會場平面圖的哪裡，文字內容已核准。送去時，請翻到平面圖那頁並放一張可取下的紙條，不要直接在紙上留下記號。如果他們要求加寬折頁留白，請把那本拿回給我。量出所需空間前，先不要改版面。
audioScript: The conference programs are printed, but please hold the full batch at the binding station. At twelve, we’ll bring one finished copy to the reception desk. When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper. If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me. Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.
